notes.title: Major Update 3 : Improved Graphics & New Tutorial
notes.notes:
🚀 What’s New in BUMP

🛡️ Introducing the SHIELD System

 A brand-new feature in BUMP! Your shield adds a strategic layer to gameplay. The less shield you have remaining, the stronger the bump force you endure when hit, and the longer your inputs are disabled. This creates a dangerous cycle where getting hit makes you more vulnerable, making every decision critical to your survival.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048077/7cbe669ac17654d7ba76852ca356c12f69c89172.png
🎓 Skill-Focused Tutorial

     We’ve introduced a brand-new tutorial experience to help you master the game’s mechanics:

 Core skills: Jump, Dash, Wall Run, Shoot, Bullet Time, and Melee.
 Advanced techniques: Perfect the Dash Bullet Time combo in a dedicated training map!

[previewyoutube=QgoXDlMjuJw;full][/previewyoutube]
🌟 Visual Enhancements

 A sleek, redesigned main menu with stunning Cyberpunk-inspired visuals for a sharper and more immersive start to your gameplay.
 Two new maps, including one featuring the Cyberpunk aesthetic we’ve always envisioned, filled with dynamic visuals.
 Enhanced VFX that make every action explode with energy and style.

[previewyoutube=zFrTvwr8FSY;full][/previewyoutube]
🎵 Audio Upgrades

 Authentic footstep sounds to heighten immersion.
 New music tracks to keep the intensity high during matches.
 A satisfying typing sound plays as dialogue text appears, adding a delightful touch of personality to every conversation.


This is just the beginning! Dive into the latest update, explore the upgrades, and take your skills to the next level. The arena is waiting for you!

notes.title: Major Update 2: Brand New UI, Improved Gameplay, and More!
notes.notes:
🚀 What's New:

🖥️ Complete UI Overhaul

 We’ve completely revamped the game’s UI, including menus, in-game HUD, player lists, bump indicators, and even the spectator mode! Everything looks sharper, smoother, and more intuitive, ensuring you stay fully immersed in the action at all times.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048077/d7df8c9e490479d9831b50d95b6fef48bd8c153a.png

🏃Enhanced Motion-Matching Animations

 Get ready for the most realistic movement you’ve seen in BUMP yet! With Unreal Engine 5's latest motion-matching technology, your character’s running animations have never felt smoother and more lifelike. Every turn, sprint, and movement reacts fluidly in sync with your inputs.

[previewyoutube=dJKSmlLoc8A;full][/previewyoutube]

💥 Explosive Gameplay Features

 Shots now explode upon hitting players or terrain, creating a powerful blast that bumps players away! Whether you're chasing down enemies or dodging incoming fire, this update makes every shot feel impactful, and standing still is no longer a safe option!
 The dash-bullet time combo is now easier to pull off, making it more accessible for new players to master, while still offering satisfying mastery for veterans.


🔄 Rounds System + Spectator Mode

 We’ve introduced a new rounds system that automatically calculates the number of rounds based on player count, eliminating players at the end of each round and raising the stakes for every moment.
 Spectator Mode is here! Once you’ve been eliminated, jump into spectator mode and follow the remaining players from different camera angles, or freely float around the map to catch all the action.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048077/47253199cccb0b2e38163cece325d65dee04c887.png

⚡ Performance Optimizations

 Performance has been greatly improved, allowing BUMP to run at 60+ FPS even when hosting, on a wide range of systems. No more stuttering or lag — just smooth, uninterrupted fun!


This is just the beginning! We're committed to constantly improving BUMP, adding even more features, gameplay modes, and surprises in future updates. Stay tuned for more exciting additions coming your way!

Get back into the game and feel the difference — see you in the arena!
